newsitem.title: USA: Schawk chief financial officer resigns.
newsitem.headline: Schawk chief financial officer resigns.

text.p: Schawk Inc said Tuesday that its chief financial officer Marie Meisenbach Graul has resigned to pursue personal interests.
Graul, who will continue as a consultant, had served as Schawk's chief financial officer since 1994.
Schawk hired an executive search firm to assist in finding Graul's permanent successor.

Schawk supplies electronic digitized high resolution color imaging, database management and on-site facility management for the food, beverage and consumer products packaging, point of sale and advertising markets.
